description: Prime-Directive code review agent. Reviews a codebase (local path, UNC path, owner/repo@ref, or archive) for reliability and performance optimization: most reliability at the lowest performance cost. Language coverage: JavaScript AST + Rust structural tier-0 analysis; every snapshotted text file (including config, docs, data, and extensionless files) remains model-review eligible, with generic analysis and explicit reduced-coverage reporting. Direct parallel pipeline: deterministic dependency graphs, boundary classification, defensive-pattern hunts, and target ranking; top-ranked targets are reviewed in parallel isolated calls with 1-hop context and a deterministic bias validator. Report-first: diffs and executable tests are generated only on accept. The automated acceptance gate is JavaScript-only and refuses other languages rather than generating mismatched Node tests. Findings persist in nDB keyed by snapshot hash + model.

tools.name: codereview_review
tools.description: Run a code review. source: absolute local path, UNC path (\\server\share\dir), 'owner/repo' or 'owner/repo@ref' (GitHub), or path to a .zip/.tar.gz archive. JavaScript and Rust receive language-specific tier-0 analysis; every other text file (including config and docs) remains review eligible with generic analysis and explicit coverage disclosure. Optional model: gateway model id (default from config; unknown id fails loudly). Optional budget: { maxFiles, concurrency, maxDurationMs, maxTokens, perFileTimeoutMs } (defaults: 12 files, 4 concurrent, 240s wall clock, 400k tokens, 120s/file). Optional scope: { include, exclude } — snapshot-relative path prefixes to narrow the review. Returns the full report (with per-target token/cost/latency ledger) and a reviewId; the report is also written under data/codereview/reviews/<reviewId>/report.md. If individual targets fail or budget stops early, returns partial:true and a PARTIAL report preserving completed findings.

source.description: Local path, UNC path, owner/repo[@ref], or archive file path

model.description: Optional gateway chat model id override

tools.name: codereview_findings
tools.description: List persisted findings. Filter by reviewId, status (new|accepted|rejected|unprovable), or snapshotHash. Returns compact records: id, file, lines, class, status, failure_mode. Full detail (evidence, rung, test_spec, suggestion) via the report or nDB directly.

tools.name: codereview_accept
tools.description: Accept a JavaScript finding: generates the diff + executable test (orchestrator model), then runs the acceptance gate in a sandbox — the test MUST fail on the unpatched snapshot and pass on the patched one. Findings whose bug cannot be reproduced in a static sandbox are marked unprovable instead of verified. Non-JavaScript findings are refused loudly before generation; verify those with the project's native test runner. Returns verdict, diff, and test code.

findingId.description: Finding id from codereview.findings or the report
